label: Each of the four local interfaces can be omitted while the other three hold on the same Nat/Option…
meaning: Without the bound use constant some(0) and no issuance; without the trigger use all-none/no-issuance; without emission use all-none/all-issuance; without forwarding output own code at every station with all-issuance. Each retains the other THREE interfaces, falsifies the omitted one and fails the full action law. Same station/code carrier and meanings throughout; no global minimality or actual/metaphysical possibility inferred.
